title: Ultimate UI V2 recode
features:
Ultimate UI v2 (RECODE):

Destroy, win, and do whatever your heart desires. In this script you’ll find features like:

ESP – enable a beautiful ESP with convenient customization for planes and missiles, including a nice and clear trail that makes dodging very easy and lets you see the whole situation on the battlefield. (now more optimised)

Teleport – an insanely powerful feature that lets you stick to ANY enemy from behind and destroy them without putting yourself at risk at all (lil outdated)

Aircraft modificator – engine modifiers that let you fly with the engine turned off (including with no fuel), increase its power, and enable ultra-maneuverability mode. (now more optimised)

Fly – the most powerful feature, letting you enable controlled flight and move left, right, up, etc. at incredible speed (and more). It makes you feel like a god (like in Minecraft creative mode), easily fly around enemies, troll them, spam missiles at insane speed, etc. (now more optimised, lil outdated)

Infinite ammo & fuel - fly infinity, spam rockets to innoccent people and watch their reaction xD. (credits for this two functions due to @bsiw) (now more optimised)

UI – a convenient and optimized UI with almost no bugs, with the ability to destroy/close it and more in the GUI tab. (now more optimised)
